page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. The memory configuration consists of 128.0 GB of RAM, providing 4.0 GB of memory per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it is provisioned with a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the instance in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. The Intel Xeon processor delivers a single-core stress-ng score of 1436.68 and a multi-core score of 30666.35, supported by AVX-512 instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 VNNI. Memory bandwidth tests show 1705.41 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 109.89 GB/sec for large-block reads. In application-specific benchmarks, the instance achieves a Redis SET throughput of 28.91 million operations per second and a static web serving throughput of 21.45 GB/sec. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the system processes 1539.55 tokens per second for prompt processing on a 135M parameter model.

Lacking local NVMe storage, the ecs.hfg6.8xlarge relies entirely on network-attached storage, which introduces potential I/O latency tradeoffs for storage-heavy applications. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio offer a balanced resource profile for general-purpose workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for multi-threaded applications that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of hyperthreading. Best-fit workloads include static web serving, database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
